macos_public_boundary_green.result: GREEN: 3 Unix public-boundary tests ran on macOS. They verified current and shell-safe alternate executable guidance, missing-server agent start and unchecked live handoff, and the post-protocol-check subscription race returning id cli:agent:wait and code server_not_running.

risk_proportional_check.result: Partial GREEN only: inventory validation, fork contracts, diff check, native format/clippy, 2979 Rust tests, 2 integration-asset tests, 12 plugin-marketplace tests, and distribution/formal checks passed. The job exited 101 at macOS-to-Windows MSVC clippy because vendored libsqlite3-sys could not find stdlib.h.

maintenance_green.result: GREEN: the 11 maintenance Python modules ran 106 tests successfully; P428 mailbox G9 inventory, the 175-commit v0.8 inventory, and 11 current distribution-guidance files were current.

powershell_formatter_green.result: GREEN: the pure formatter fixed Unix's existing command and full message, plus PowerShell's explicit message and ampersand-prefixed, single-quoted executable/session command. Three macOS Unix public-boundary tests also passed; inventory validation and diff check passed.
